entries.message: Ran Hermes session setup and loaded the optimized Codex and OMX bridge context.
Inspected RaceController, RaceEventRepository, RaceControllerTests, and the race detail page to confirm the saved-state dependency should become a lightweight name-based summary lookup.
Added failing RaceControllerTests coverage for saved-status unauthorized, blank-name, found, and not-found cases.
Added GET /api/races/saved-status and a repository lookup path that avoids hydrating the decorated /api/races list.
Targeted RaceControllerTests passed after the controller and repository changes.
Backend compile passed with tests skipped, completing the lane verification set.
